entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Judy, and you've reached VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Hi Judy. I'd like to make a return. I bought a Trail Helmet a few weeks ago, and it's just not what I was looking for.
Oh, of course. No problem at all. I can certainly help you with that return.
Really? That's great. I wasn't sure if I had missed the window.
Not at all! Our return policy is for 90 days, so you're well within the timeframe. I see here you're a VIP customer with us, so I can expedite this for you. I've just initiated the refund process.
Wow, that was fast. Thank you.

You're very welcome. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just print that out and attach it to the box. You'll see the refund on your original payment method as soon as the item is scanned at the post office.
That's fantastic service. I really appreciate it.
It's my pleasure! As an extra thank you for being a loyal VeloFit member, I've also added a 15% discount coupon to your account for your next order. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help, Judy.
Happy to assist. Thanks again for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
